readiness.hed: Fredericksburg stays mild and sunny through the evening near 68, drops to a chilly, partly cloudy 34 overnight, then holds a sunny-to-partly-sunny pattern in the mid-to-upper 60s into the weekend before a slight chance of rain rolls in Saturday night
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service shows no active watches or warnings for Fredericksburg this afternoon. Temperatures hold near 68 this afternoon before falling toward 60 later on a light south breeze, then drop to a partly cloudy low near 34 overnight. Friday turns sunny again near 69, with a partly cloudy Friday night near 37. Saturday eases to partly sunny near 66, and Saturday night brings the week's first chance of rain — 20% — with a low near 46 as a weekend system starts to move in.
actions: A low near 34 tonight is cold enough for a light frost on exposed surfaces — give the car a few extra minutes to defrost and bring in sensitive plants overnight.
Dry, calm conditions through Saturday afternoon are a good window for outdoor errands, yard cleanup, or a church outdoor event before Saturday night's rain chance.
Friday night's low near 37 is another reminder to drain or cover outdoor spigots and hoses before the weekend.
Saturday night's 20% rain chance is worth watching if Sunday travel plans are still being set — check the forecast again Saturday morning for an update.
